hero.title: DOGTOR
hero.subtitle: Helping every student find <hl>a way of learning that fits</hl>.
hero.body: DOGTOR is an AI learning app developed and operated by SuperB Software. This is its story: why we built it, which learning problem it tackles, and what we want to explore next.

problem.title: Studying hard, without knowing where you're stuck.
problem.body: Traditional revision often turns into endless drilling, without revealing the concepts students actually struggle with. Students put in the time but can't focus it where it matters most — and parents find it hard to understand how their children are doing.

points.blind: Scores are visible; weak concepts are not

approach.title: Start from concepts, so practice has direction.
approach.body: A knowledge graph connects questions, knowledge scores and review timing; AI and game-like design keep students practising and show them what comes next.

knowledge.title: Knowledge graph and scores
knowledge.body: Answers map to knowledge points, scoring mastery of each concept and scheduling personalized review by performance and timing.

ai.title: AI question bank with multi-model checks
ai.body: Questions are generated by curriculum, chapter and knowledge point, then cross-checked by multiple models — covering nearly all Taiwanese secondary subjects plus SAT and AP.

personal.title: An AI companion that remembers
personal.body: The conversational AI remembers each student's struggles, interests and study context, adapting its responses and concept hints.

play.title: Playful and social
play.body: Learning islands, friends and live battles turn revision into a habit students want to open every day.

steps.practice: Simulated tests: instant feedback, tracking mastery of every knowledge point
steps.diagnose: Error classification: uploaded questions map to knowledge points and build a personal error log
steps.ai: AI companion: remembers each student's weak spots and context to give the right hints
steps.progress: Parent reports: daily learning results delivered straight to LINE

impact.title: Being genuinely used by students is the result we care about most.
impact.body: We only publish verified, dated figures and update them regularly.

beyond.title: Not just features — a way to understand learning.
beyond.body: DOGTOR's value goes beyond features. We learn from real study behaviour, and the team is conducting HCI research related to DOGTOR on how AI can help students while leaving room for thinking and understanding — the research is ongoing, with no formal findings yet.

cta.title: Want the full feature list or to download the app?
cta.body: Features, downloads, subscriptions and support all live on the DOGTOR website.

hero.title: Starting with education, <hl>centered on people</hl>.

story.title: It began with something we noticed in education.
story.body: SuperB began in the tutoring classroom. Since 2023 we have worked with Superb Education, stepping into frontline teaching — and having gone through Taiwan's exam system ourselves, we now teach other students too. We saw that many students do want to learn, but traditional practice lacks instant interaction and feedback, making it hard to keep a rhythm or see where they're really stuck. So our NTU student team joined forces with Superb Education's teachers, guided by NTU professors, to build DOGTOR. Along the way we learned to start from real users and improve from feedback, and we now bring that approach to more areas.

Solutions.processTitle: Build the right tool around your workflow.

understand.title: Understand the need
understand.body: Show us how things work today, what takes the most time and what teachers, parents or staff need.

design.title: Make the idea tangible
design.body: Define priorities, workflows and interface prototypes, then agree on scope, timing and cost.

build.title: Build, connect and improve
build.body: Develop a website, app or LINE tool, connect your existing data and services, and refine it with real feedback.

Solutions.faqEyebrow: A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT ASK
Solutions.faqTitle: A few questions before we start.

ready.q: Are these tools ready to buy?
ready.a: This page describes custom development directions. Features are scoped around your teaching context, data and integrations. Visit Products & Partnerships for existing products such as DOGTOR.

integrate.q: Can you connect LINE, spreadsheets or our existing system?
integrate.a: We can assess this together. Share your tools, data formats and expected workflow so we can check APIs, imports and access permissions before proposing an integration.

scope.q: Can a small tutoring center start with a custom tool?
scope.a: Start with one workflow, such as homework reminders, arrival alerts or grade reports. We will discuss users, essential features and budget to define an appropriate first step.

ai.q: Can teachers review AI-generated questions, grades and messages?
ai.a: Yes. The workflow can let AI prepare drafts or suggestions for teachers to review before publishing, recording grades or sending messages, with an edit and action history.
